# Load and Organize Data

```{r}
seed = 1
set.seed(1)
# Load data from southern African database

# set directory
dir = here::here()

# Load data from external code
za_count <- read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/za_count_site.csv"))
za_count_taph <- read_csv(paste0(dir, '/data/za_count_site_taph.csv'))

# read in and modify data names and assign as date list for c14bazAAR
c14_za <- read_csv(paste0(dir, "/data/SARD_Mar2021_14C.csv")) |>
  rename(c14age = Date, c14std = Uncertainty,  labnr = 'Lab ID',
         lon = DecdegE, lat = DecdegS,
         material = 'Material dated', species = Species,
         Industry =`Archaeological Sub-chronology`,
         SiteType = `Site Type`) |>
  filter(Industry %in% c('Robberg', 'Oakhurst',
                         'Wilton', 'Ceramic LSA', 'Final LSA', 
                         'ELSA', 'ELSA/transitional'),
         
         Country %in% c('South Africa', 'Lesotho')) |>
  mutate(c14age = as.numeric(c14age),
         c14std = as.numeric(c14std),
         
         Industry = ifelse(Industry == 'ELSA/transitional', 'ELSA', Industry),
         Industry = ifelse(Industry == 'Ceramic LSA', 'Final LSA', Industry)) |>
  
  as.c14_date_list()

za_df <- za_count %>%
  left_join(c14_za %>% 
               select(Site, labnr, Industry, `SiteType`, lat, lon, Country),
             by = c('Site', 'labnr')) %>%
  group_by(site_bins) %>%
  arrange(Industry) %>%
  mutate(Industry = first(Industry)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  arrange(lat) %>%
  mutate(lat = first(lat),
         lon = first(lon)) %>%
  arrange(Country) %>%
  mutate(Country = first(Country)) %>%
  arrange(`SiteType`) %>%
  mutate(`Site Type` = first(`SiteType`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(SiteType = ifelse(`SiteType` %in% c('shell midden', 
                                              'settlement'),
                           'Intensification', 
                           ifelse(is.na(`SiteType`), 'Unknown', 
                                  `SiteType`)),
         SiteType = factor(SiteType),
         Zone_Name = factor(Zone_Name))



za_df_taph <- za_count_taph %>%
  left_join(c14_za %>% 
              select(Site, labnr, Industry, `SiteType`, lat, lon, Country),
            by = c('Site', 'labnr')) %>%
  group_by(site_bins) %>%
  arrange(Industry) %>%
  mutate(Industry = first(Industry)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(Site) %>%
  arrange(lat) %>%
  mutate(lat = first(lat),
         lon = first(lon)) %>%
  arrange(Country) %>%
  mutate(Country = first(Country)) %>%
  arrange(`SiteType`) %>%
  mutate(`SiteType` = first(`SiteType`)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(SiteType = ifelse(`SiteType` %in% c('shell midden', 
                                              'settlement'),
                           'Intensification', 
                           ifelse(is.na(`SiteType`), 'Unknown', 
                                  `SiteType`)),
         SiteType = factor(SiteType),
         Zone_Name = factor(Zone_Name))

```

## Site count Vs Time

```{r}

# this model shows cluster show almost no variation after accounting for mean site count
my_prior <-
  prior(normal(0, 1), class ='Intercept')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b')+
  
  prior(beta(1, 1), class = 'zi')

seed <- 77177
fit_space <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)


seed <- 77277
fit_space_taph <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df_taph,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed
)

```

```{r}

pred_grid <- tibble(
    time_ka = seq(
      min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    )
  )

pred <- posterior_epred(
  fit_space,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


pred_summary <- pred %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(paste0("draw_", seq_len(ncol(.)))) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_grid) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("draw_"),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "mu"
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_ka) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(mu),
    lower = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)) %>%
  filter(calBP < 27000, calBP > 1500)


png(paste0(dir, "/results/figures/Fig5A.png"), 
    width = 2200, height = 800, res = 300)

ggplot() +
  
  # Observed site counts
  #geom_line(
  #data = fit_df %>% filter(calBP > 500, calBP < 29000),
  #aes(
  #x = calBP,
  #y = site_count
  #),
  #stat = "identity"
  #) +
  
  #scale_fill_gradient(low = "darkorange", high = "darkblue") 
  
  # Bayesian credible interval
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.25,
    fill = "black",
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # Posterior mean prediction
  geom_line(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      y = estimate
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    color = 'black'
  ) +
  
  # Reverse BP axis
  scale_x_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Calibrated Years BP",
    y = 'Radiocarbon Count',
    fill = "Site Count"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

dev.off()
```

### Change Points

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_3cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3),
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1,
  beta2 ~ 1,
  beta3 ~ 1,
  beta4 ~ 1,
  
  cp1 ~ 1,
  cp2 ~ 1,
  cp3 ~ 1,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_3cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(12, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(6.3, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(2.12, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  )
)

seed <- seed + 1

fit_time_3cp <- brm(
  model_fit_3cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- seed + 1

fit_time_3cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_3cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 1,
  iter = 4000,
  warmup = 2000,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)

```

```{r}
draws_cp3 <- as_draws_df(fit_time_3cp) %>%
  mutate(
    
    # change point 1
    slope_before_cp1 =
      b_beta1_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp1 =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp2 =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept + b_beta3_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp3 =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept + 
      b_beta3_Intercept + b_beta4_Intercept,
    
    CP1 = b_cp1_Intercept,
    CP2 = b_cp2_Intercept,
    CP3 = b_cp3_Intercept
  )

draws_cp3 |>
  select(slope_before_cp1:slope_after_cp3) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Slope",
    values_to = "cp"
  ) |>
  group_by(Slope) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(cp),
    lower = quantile(cp, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(cp, 0.975)
  )

draws_cp3 |>
  select(CP1:CP3) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "ChangePoint",
    values_to = "cp"
  ) |>
  group_by(ChangePoint) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(cp),
    lower = quantile(cp, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(cp, 0.975),
    
    calBP_estimate = (-estimate * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  )





draws_cp3 %>%
  summarize('P(CP1 < CP2)1' = 
              mean(b_cp1_Intercept -
                     b_cp2_Intercept < 0),
            'P(CP2 < CP3)1' = 
              mean(b_cp2_Intercept -
                     b_cp3_Intercept < 0),
            'P(CP1 < CP3)1' = 
              mean(b_cp1_Intercept -
                     b_cp3_Intercept < 0)) %>%
  
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = 'Contrast', 
               values_to = 'Probability')

  
```

```{r}

my_prior <-
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept')+
  
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'stime_ka:Zone_NameS_1')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'stime_ka:Zone_NameW_1')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'stime_ka:Zone_NameY_1')+
  
  prior(exponential(1), class = 'sd', coef = 'Intercept', group = 'Zone_Name')+
  
  prior(beta(1, 1), class = 'zi')

seed <- 77795837
fit_time_rfz_s <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka, by = Zone_Name) + (1|Zone_Name),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- 1111142
fit_time_rfz_s_taph <- brm(
  site_count ~ 1 + s(time_ka, by = Zone_Name) + (1|Zone_Name),
  
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  
  data = fit_df_taph,
  
  prior = my_prior,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)
```

```{r}
pred_grid <- tibble(
  time_ka = seq(
    min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
    length.out = 100
  )
) %>%
  expand_grid(
    Zone_Name = unique(fit_df$Zone_Name)
  )

pred <- posterior_epred(
  fit_time_rfz_s,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


pred_summary <- pred %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(paste0("draw_", seq_len(ncol(.)))) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_grid) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("draw_"),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "mu"
  ) %>%
  group_by(time_ka, Zone_Name) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(mu),
    lower = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)) %>%
  filter(calBP < 27000, calBP > 1500)


png(paste0(dir, "/results/figures/Fig6A.png"), 
    width = 2200, height = 800, res = 300)

ggplot() +
  
  geom_ribbon(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.25,
    fill = "black",
    color = NA
  ) +
  
  # Posterior mean prediction
  geom_line(
    data = pred_summary,
    aes(
      x = calBP,
      y = estimate
    ),
    linewidth = 1,
    color = 'black'
  ) +
  
  facet_wrap(~Zone_Name, scales = 'free') +
  
  # Reverse BP axis
  scale_x_reverse() +
  
  labs(
    x = "Calibrated Years BP",
    y = 'Radiocarbon Count',
    fill = "Site Count"
  ) +
  
  theme_minimal(base_size = 8)

dev.off()
```

### Change Points

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_rfz_3cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3),
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta2 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta3 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta4 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  
  cp1 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp2 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp3 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_rfz_3cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(12, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(6.3, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(2.12, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  )
)

seed <- seed + 1

fit_time_rfz_3cp <- brm(
  model_fit_rfz_3cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_rfz_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- seed + 1

fit_time_rfz_3cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_rfz_3cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_rfz_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)

```

### Tests

```{r}
library(brms)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(posterior)

zones <- levels(factor(fit_df$Zone_Name))
nd <- data.frame(Zone_Name = factor(zones, levels = levels(factor(fit_df$Zone_Name))),
                 time_ka = 0)

# draws x zones matrix for each nonlinear parameter
get_par <- function(par) posterior_linpred(fit_time_rfz_3cp, newdata = nd, nlpar = par)

p <- lapply(c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","cp1","cp2","cp3"), get_par)
names(p) <- c("beta1","beta2","beta3","beta4","cp1","cp2","cp3")

# Slopes (log-rate per ka), oldest -> youngest segments
# Segment ordering assumes cp1 > cp2 > cp3 (older -> younger)
slopes <- list(
  seg_young_of_cp3   = p$beta1,                              # t < cp3
  seg_cp3_to_cp2     = p$beta1 + p$beta4,                    # cp3 < t < cp2
  seg_cp2_to_cp1     = p$beta1 + p$beta4 + p$beta3,          # cp2 < t < cp1
  seg_older_than_cp1 = p$beta1 + p$beta4 + p$beta3 + p$beta2 # t > cp1
)

summ <- function(m, name) {
  data.frame(
    Zone_Name = zones,
    quantity  = name,
    mean   = colMeans(m),
    median = apply(m, 2, median),
    lower  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.025),
    upper  = apply(m, 2, quantile, 0.975)
  )
}

cp_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$cp1, "CP1 (Robberg/Oakhurst)"),
  summ(p$cp2, "CP2 (Oakhurst/Wilton)"),
  summ(p$cp3, "CP3 (Wilton/final LSA)")
)

slope_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(slopes), function(n) summ(slopes[[n]], n)))

# Slope before/after each change point (younger vs older side), plus % change per ka
ba <- list(
  CP3_younger = slopes$seg_young_of_cp3,   CP3_older = slopes$seg_cp3_to_cp2,
  CP2_younger = slopes$seg_cp3_to_cp2,     CP2_older = slopes$seg_cp2_to_cp1,
  CP1_younger = slopes$seg_cp2_to_cp1,     CP1_older = slopes$seg_older_than_cp1
)
ba_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ba), function(n) summ(ba[[n]], n)))
pct_summary <- bind_rows(lapply(names(ba), function(n) summ(exp(ba[[n]]) - 1, paste0(n, "_pct"))))

# Slope change at each CP (just the hinge coefficient), with P(change > 0)
change_summary <- bind_rows(
  summ(p$beta4, "slope change at CP3"),
  summ(p$beta3, "slope change at CP2"),
  summ(p$beta2, "slope change at CP1")
)
pd <- c(CP3 = colMeans(p$beta4 > 0), CP2 = colMeans(p$beta3 > 0), CP1 = colMeans(p$beta2 > 0))

print(change_summary)
```

```{r}
draws_rfz_cp3 <- as_draws_df(fit_time_rfz_3cp) %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Summer change points
    slope_before_cp1_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp1_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp2_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept + b_beta3_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp3_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept + 
      b_beta3_Intercept + b_beta4_Intercept,
    
    CP1_summer = b_cp1_Zone_NameS,
    CP2_summer = b_cp2_Zone_NameS,
    CP3_summer = b_cp3_Zone_NameS,
    
    
    # Winter change points
    slope_before_cp1_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW,
    
    slope_after_cp1_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW + b_beta2_Zone_NameW ,
    
    slope_after_cp2_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW + b_beta2_Zone_NameW  + b_beta3_Zone_NameW,
    
    slope_after_cp3_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW + b_beta2_Zone_NameW  + 
      b_beta3_Zone_NameW + b_beta4_Zone_NameW,
    
    CP1_winter = b_cp1_Zone_NameW,
    CP2_winter = b_cp2_Zone_NameW,
    CP3_winter = b_cp3_Zone_NameW,
    
    
    # Yearround change points
    slope_before_cp1_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY,
    
    slope_after_cp1_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY + b_beta2_Zone_NameY ,
    
    slope_after_cp2_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY + b_beta2_Zone_NameY  + b_beta3_Zone_NameY,
    
    slope_after_cp3_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY + b_beta2_Zone_NameY  + 
      b_beta3_Zone_NameY + b_beta4_Zone_NameY,
    
    CP1_yearround = b_cp1_Zone_NameY,
    CP2_yearround = b_cp2_Zone_NameY,
    CP3_yearround = b_cp3_Zone_NameY,
    
  )

draws_rfz_cp3 |>
  select(slope_before_cp1_summer:slope_after_cp3_summer,
         slope_before_cp1_winter:slope_after_cp3_winter,
         slope_before_cp1_yearround:slope_after_cp3_yearround) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Slope",
    values_to = "RFZ"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Slope) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(RFZ),
    lower = quantile(RFZ, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(RFZ, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  mutate('Period' = str_split_i(Slope, '_', 2),
         'Change Point' = str_split_i(Slope, '_', 3),
         'RFZ' = str_split_i(Slope, '_', 4)) %>%
  mutate(`Change Point` = ifelse(Period == 'before', 'cp0', `Change Point`)) %>%
  arrange(`Change Point`) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = `Change Point`, color = RFZ))+
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                 width = 0.8)+
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
    )



draws_rfz_cp3 |>
  select(CP1_summer:CP3_summer,
         CP1_winter:CP3_winter,
         CP1_yearround:CP3_yearround) |>
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "ChangePoint",
    values_to = "cp"
  ) |>
  group_by(ChangePoint) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(cp),
    lower = quantile(cp, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(cp, 0.975),
    
    calBP_estimate = (-estimate * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  ) %>%
  mutate('Change Point' = str_split_i(ChangePoint, '_', 1),
         'RFZ' = str_split_i(ChangePoint, '_', 2)) %>%
  arrange(`Change Point`) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = calBP_estimate, y = `Change Point`, color = RFZ))+
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = calBP_lwr, xmax = calBP_upr),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                 width = 0.8)+
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse()
```

### Change Points

```{r}
# Global change point
hinge_fun <- stanvar(
  scode = "
  real hinge(real x, real cp) {
    return fmax(0, x - cp);
  }
  ",
  block = "functions"
)


# Three change points per region
model_fit_site_3cp <- bf(
  site_count ~ alpha +
    beta1 * time_ka +
    beta2 * hinge(time_ka, cp1) +
    beta3 * hinge(time_ka, cp2) +
    beta4 * hinge(time_ka, cp3),
  
  alpha ~ 1,
  beta1 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta2 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta3 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  beta4 ~ 1 + Zone_Name,
  
  cp1 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp2 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  cp3 ~ 0 + Zone_Name,
  
  nl = TRUE
)


prior_fit_site_3cp <- c(
  
  # baseline
  prior(
    normal(0, 1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "alpha"
  ),
  
  # initial slope
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta1"
  ),
  
  # slope change at CP1
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta2"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP2
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta3"
  ),
  
  # additional slope change at CP3
  prior(
    normal(0, 0.1),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "beta4"
  ),
  
  # CP1
  # third change point from Robberg to Oakhurst
  prior(
    normal(12, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp1"
  ),
  
  # CP2
  # second change point from Oakhurst to wilton
  prior(
    normal(6.3, 0.5),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp2"
  ),
  
  # CP3
  # last change point from Wilton to final LSA
  prior(
    normal(2.12, 2),
    class = "b",
    nlpar = "cp3"
  )
)

seed <- seed + 1

fit_time_site_3cp <- brm(
  model_fit_site_3cp,
  data = fit_df,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_site_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)


seed <- seed + 1

fit_time_rfz_3cp_taph <- brm(
  model_fit_rfz_3cp,
  data = fit_df_taph,
  family = zero_inflated_poisson(),
  prior = prior_fit_rfz_3cp,
  
  stanvars = hinge_fun,
  
  chains = 2,
  iter = 1000,
  warmup = 500,
  
  cores = 4,
  threads = threading(8),
  backend = 'cmdstanr',
  seed = seed,
  
  sample_prior = 'yes'
)

```

```{r}
draws_rfz_cp3 <- as_draws_df(fit_time_rfz_3cp) %>%
  mutate(
    
    # Summer change points
    slope_before_cp1_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp1_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp2_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept + b_beta3_Intercept,
    
    slope_after_cp3_summer =
      b_beta1_Intercept + b_beta2_Intercept + 
      b_beta3_Intercept + b_beta4_Intercept,
    
    CP1_summer = b_cp1_Zone_NameS,
    CP2_summer = b_cp2_Zone_NameS,
    CP3_summer = b_cp3_Zone_NameS,
    
    
    # Winter change points
    slope_before_cp1_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW,
    
    slope_after_cp1_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW + b_beta2_Zone_NameW ,
    
    slope_after_cp2_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW + b_beta2_Zone_NameW  + b_beta3_Zone_NameW,
    
    slope_after_cp3_winter =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameW + b_beta2_Zone_NameW  + 
      b_beta3_Zone_NameW + b_beta4_Zone_NameW,
    
    CP1_winter = b_cp1_Zone_NameW,
    CP2_winter = b_cp2_Zone_NameW,
    CP3_winter = b_cp3_Zone_NameW,
    
    
    # Yearround change points
    slope_before_cp1_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY,
    
    slope_after_cp1_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY + b_beta2_Zone_NameY ,
    
    slope_after_cp2_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY + b_beta2_Zone_NameY  + b_beta3_Zone_NameY,
    
    slope_after_cp3_yearround =
      b_beta1_Zone_NameY + b_beta2_Zone_NameY  + 
      b_beta3_Zone_NameY + b_beta4_Zone_NameY,
    
    CP1_yearround = b_cp1_Zone_NameY,
    CP2_yearround = b_cp2_Zone_NameY,
    CP3_yearround = b_cp3_Zone_NameY,
    
  )

draws_rfz_cp3 |>
  select(slope_before_cp1_summer:slope_after_cp3_summer,
         slope_before_cp1_winter:slope_after_cp3_winter,
         slope_before_cp1_yearround:slope_after_cp3_yearround) %>%
  pivot_longer(
    everything(),
    names_to = "Slope",
    values_to = "RFZ"
  ) %>%
  group_by(Slope) %>%
  summarise(
    estimate = median(RFZ),
    lower = quantile(RFZ, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(RFZ, 0.975)
  ) %>%
  mutate('Period' = str_split_i(Slope, '_', 2),
         'Change Point' = str_split_i(Slope, '_', 3),
         'RFZ' = str_split_i(Slope, '_', 4)) %>%
  mutate(`Change Point` = ifelse(Period == 'before', 'cp0', `Change Point`)) %>%
  arrange(`Change Point`) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = estimate, y = `Change Point`, color = RFZ))+
  geom_errorbarh(aes(xmin = lower, xmax = upper),
                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                 width = 0.8)+
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  )



draws_rfz_cp3 |>
  select(CP1_summer:CP3_summer,

    everything(),
    names_to = "ChangePoint",
    values_to = "cp"
  ) |>
  group_by(ChangePoint) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(cp),
    lower = quantile(cp, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(cp, 0.975),
    
    calBP_estimate = (-estimate * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_lwr = (-lower * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP),
    calBP_upr = (-upper * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)
  ) %>%
  mutate('Change Point' = str_split_i(ChangePoint, '_', 1),
         'RFZ' = str_split_i(ChangePoint, '_', 2)) %>%
  arrange(`Change Point`) %>%
  
  ggplot(aes(x = calBP_estimate, y = `Change Point`, color = RFZ))+

                 position = position_dodge(width = 0.9),
                 width = 0.8)+
  geom_point(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)
  )
```

# Leave One Out Cross Validation

```{r}
site_sensitivity %>%
  filter(max_k > 0.2) %>%
  distinct(Site) -> sites
```

```{r}
my_prior <-
  prior(normal(0, 1), class = 'Intercept')+
  
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'time_ka')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'RFZS')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'RFZW')+
  
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'time_ka:RFZS')+
  prior(normal(0, 2), class = 'b', coef = 'time_ka:RFZW')+
  
  prior(exponential(1), class = 'sd', coef = 'Intercept', group = 'RFZ')+
  
  prior(inv_gamma(0.4, 0.3), class = 'shape')


seed <- 1777

jackknife_results <- vector("list", length(sites))
#j_TMP <- jackknife_results

for(i in 1:length(sites$Site)) {
  
  site_i <- sites$Site[i]
  
  message(
    "Fitting ", i, "/", length(sites$Site),
    ": leaving out ", site_i
  )
  
  dat_i <- fit_df %>%
    filter(Site != site_i)
  
  fit_i <- brm(
    site_count ~ 1 + time_ka * RFZ + (1 | RFZ),
    
    family = negbinomial(),
    
    data = dat_i,
    
    prior = my_prior,
    
    chains = 1,
    iter = 4000,
    warmup = 2000,
    
    control = list(adapt_delta = 0.9),
    
    cores = 4,
    threads = threading(8),
    
    backend = "cmdstanr",
    seed = seed + i
  )
  
  jackknife_results[[i]] <- list(
    site_removed = site_i,
    fit = fit_i
  )
}
```

```{r}

pred_grid <- fit_df |>
  distinct(RFZ) |>
  crossing(
    time_ka = seq(
      min(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
      max(fit_df$time_ka, na.rm = TRUE),
      length.out = 100
    )
  )

for(i in jackknife_results){


pred <- posterior_epred(
  i$fit,
  newdata = pred_grid,
  re_formula = NULL,
  allow_new_levels = TRUE
)


pred_summary <- pred %>%
  t() %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  setNames(paste0("draw_", seq_len(ncol(.)))) %>%
  bind_cols(pred_grid) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = starts_with("draw_"),
    names_to = "draw",
    values_to = "mu"
  ) |>
  group_by(time_ka, RFZ) |>
  summarise(
    estimate = median(mu),
    lower = quantile(mu, 0.025),
    upper = quantile(mu, 0.975),
    .groups = "drop"
  )


ggplot(
  pred_summary |>
    filter(!is.na(RFZ)) |>
    mutate(calBP = (-time_ka * 1000) + mean(fit_df$calBP)),
  aes(
    x = calBP,
    y = estimate,
    group = RFZ,
    linetype = RFZ
  )
) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(
      ymin = lower,
      ymax = upper
    ),
    alpha = 0.15,
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_x_reverse() +
  labs(
    x = "Time (ka cal BP)",
    y = "Estimated Radiocarbon Intensity",
    linetype = "Period",
    title = paste0(i$site_removed)
  ) +
  theme_classic() -> gg_tmp

  print(gg_tmp)
}
```
